title: No model's reply can be read, so the pass is tried again and then the host writes the requests down
expected: The first unreadable pass writes nothing and is tried again. After the second the recap holds the user's requests as the host reads them, marked as not written by the model, and claims nothing it cannot know. The next good pass reads the same turn again and fills in what the agent did.

steps.user: Add a CSV export to the orders page and a date filter above the table.

steps.agent: Both are on the orders page: a date filter above the table and an Export CSV button that exports the filtered rows.

check.why: the user is told the recap could not be written
one unreadable pass writes nothing down
the user is told this recap was not written by the model
the host wrote the user's request down itself
a recap the model could not write does not claim a request was overlooked

steps.user: make the date filter default to the last 30 days

steps.agent: The date filter defaults to the last 30 days now.

check.why: a good pass clears the degraded mark
the request the host wrote down is not listed again in the model's words
the work of the turn the model failed on is recorded
